tunables.name: ACT_LOG_KEEP
tunables.reason: how many recent actions the zone page keeps for the browser checks (combat().acts): a debug buffer size, never read by the game

tunables.name: OPEN
tunables.reason: browser API constant WebSocket.OPEN (1): not a number we choose

tunables.name: MINUTES_PER_DAY
tunables.reason: a unit fact (24 h x 60 min = 1440 minutes in a day), not a tuning: nobody tunes how long a day is in minutes; the game day's real length is the gameDayMinutes row (Lead 2026-10-18)

tunables.name: COLUMN_SALT
tunables.reason: salt that separates the smoke columns' draws from the ridges' (golden-ratio constant): part of the seed format, not tuning

branchIds.reason: the prop recipe KIND vocabulary (scatter | rim | ring | ...): the closed set of placement algorithms the kit builder switches on (props-defs.json rows name which one they use), a mechanism category, not a content id
